label: Late original-phase / delimiter steps of sequences that start with d
explanation: Fires only in sequences whose first original token is d (90% of activation mass), at late original-phase steps (t>=5, mostly 6-9) and at the <DEL> step; never in the copy phase and never at t<4. Rate rises with absolute position (orig_idx 8 has 14x lift) and so with longer L. The strongest activations occur when the second token is also f/d/q/c (e.g. d f ..., d d ...); the subset restricted to those tokens has precision 0.88 but low recall. The activation is not specific to the current input token. Misses are mostly weak activations at late steps in sequences not starting with d. False positives are d-initial sequences where it stays silent, so it is a position-gated d-at-start detector with incomplete precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: d, i, b, f, a, c; least: n, t, z, g) and the previous input (most: g, j, t, z, 2, n; least: c, w, -, d); timing cues that raise it most: t=7, t=6, L=9 & t=8.
